items.locator: DailyMed Fluoxetine Capsules — BOXED WARNING, Suicidal Thoughts and Behaviors: increased risk in pediatric and young adult patients; closely monitor for clinical worsening and emergence of suicidal thoughts and behaviors during treatment, especially early and with dose changes.
items.version: DailyMed label updated 2026-04-17; current FDA label rechecked 2026-08-15.

options.A: Monitor closely for clinical worsening and new or worsening suicidal thoughts or behaviors, especially after starting treatment or changing the dose.
options.B: Delay focused behavioral monitoring until several months of therapy have passed because early treatment does not require added observation.
options.C: Use routine follow-up without added behavioral assessment unless the adolescent has a prior suicide attempt or psychiatric hospitalization.
options.D: Rely mainly on the adolescent to report concerning changes independently because family or caregiver observation is unnecessary during early treatment.

items.rationale: The fluoxetine boxed warning requires close monitoring of pediatric and young adult patients for clinical worsening and emergence of suicidal thoughts and behaviors, particularly during early treatment and after dosage changes. Option A states the warning directly. Prior hospitalization is not required for monitoring, and observation should not be delayed or delegated solely to the adolescent.
